title: What generative AI can do · Level 1
slo: Identify what generative AI is and match it to common workplace uses.

exercises.question_text: What can designers create from a text description?

options.rationale: Campaign visuals can be created from text descriptions. This is an image and video generation use.
Support replies answer customer inquiries instead of creating visual assets. They are not campaign visuals.
Code modules support software development rather than creative visual production. They are not generated campaign visuals.
Study guides are learning materials rather than visual creative assets. They do not meet a designer's visual-production need.
options.better_fit: This fits personalized learning for students.

exercises.explanation: Correct—visuals, storyboards, and concept art fit this use.

exercises.question_text: What can Microsoft Copilot help a marketing team create? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Product descriptions are written marketing content. Copilot can help create them.
Blog posts are marketing content. Copilot can help draft them.
Social-media content is a listed marketing output. It can support consistent messaging.
Support responses address customer inquiries rather than campaign writing. They are not the stated marketing outputs.
options.better_fit: This fits an AI-powered virtual agent handling customer inquiries.

exercises.question_text: Image and video generation uses text descriptions to create custom quizzes for students.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A student-learning task would be sent to visual generation.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Image and video generation creates visuals; personalized learning creates custom quizzes.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Custom quizzes are a personalized-learning output.

exercises.question_text: Microsoft Copilot can help write marketing content while supporting consistent brand messaging across platforms.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team could overlook a useful content workflow.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Copilot can create product descriptions, blog posts, and social-media content.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It can support both faster drafting and consistent messaging.

exercises.question_text: What can GitHub Copilot generate from natural-language prompts? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: GitHub Copilot can generate code snippets. Developers can request them in natural language.
GitHub Copilot can suggest functions. This supports implementation work.
GitHub Copilot can write modules. Modules are a listed code-generation output.
Storyboards are visual creative assets rather than code outputs. They are not generated as software modules or functions.
options.better_fit: This fits image and video generation.

options.rationale: Generative AI produces new material such as text, images, or other content. Creating new content is the defining capability.
Scoring assesses an output that already exists. Generative AI produces the output instead.
options.better_fit: This fits an evaluator used to measure output quality.

options.rationale: An agent combines a model, instructions, and actions to pursue tasks. Generative AI names the content-creation capability itself.
options.better_fit: This fits an agent configured to use tools for a task.

options.text: A system that routes customer tickets
options.rationale: Ticket routing organizes support work rather than creating new content. It is not the definition of generative AI.
options.better_fit: This fits a customer-service workflow or support automation system.

exercises.question_text: GitHub Copilot can suggest functions and generate code from natural-language prompts.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A developer could overlook a useful coding aid.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GitHub Copilot can generate snippets, suggest functions, and write modules.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It supports code generation from plain-language prompts.

exercises.question_text: Generative AI is a fixed field whose capabilities change slowly.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would underestimate how quickly the field changes.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Generative AI can change how people work, and developments in the area move quickly.

exercises.question_text: What can an AI-powered virtual agent do for customers?

options.rationale: Virtual agents understand and answer customer questions in natural language. This supports customer service.
Product descriptions are marketing content rather than customer support. They do not answer customer inquiries.
options.better_fit: This fits marketing content with Copilot.

options.rationale: Code modules support software development rather than customer service. They do not provide answers to customer questions.
Concept art is a visual creative asset rather than a support response. It does not address customer questions.
options.better_fit: This fits image and video generation from a text description.

exercises.question_text: What can generative AI create for personalized learning? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Custom quizzes are a personalized-learning output. They can reflect learner needs.
Explanations can be tailored to a learner. They support personalized learning.
Study guides can be customized for learners. They are a listed output.
Support tickets concern customer-service workflows rather than learning materials. They are not personalized educational content.
options.better_fit: This fits customer-support workflows and virtual-agent operations.

exercises.explanation: Correct—these materials can be tailored to learners.

exercises.question_text: AI-powered virtual agents create custom quizzes tailored to student progress.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A learning task would be assigned to support.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Virtual agents answer customer inquiries; personalized learning creates tailored quizzes.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Custom quizzes are for personalized learning.

exercises.question_text: Generative AI can tailor quizzes, explanations, and study guides to a student's learning style and progress.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A learner could miss appropriate support.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Personalized learning can create quizzes, explanations, and study guides matched to a learner.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Learning style and progress can guide tailoring.

flashcards.back: A subset of AI that creates new content.
It can write product descriptions, blog posts, and social-media content.
They answer customer questions in natural language.
Tailored quizzes, explanations, and study guides.
